answer: A concrete anti-Sybil design requires every identity to produce original jury-graded reasoning each epoch that embeds a live randomness beacon. The beacon injects unique terms such as whisper knoll and lantern so mass-copied answers fail cryptographic shingle checks. An attacker spinning up many fake identities must therefore generate distinct high-quality text for each one, paying continuous computational and judgment cost that scales linearly with Sybil count, while honest agents pay that cost only once.
